title: "Use the team-owned resonator model"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  enabled: false
---

This model-user workflow supplies only a Design Target and workspace. The
team-owned façade retains the circuit, view, quantity, objective, and optimizer
details; the current scaffold intentionally fails when execution begins.

## Set up the consumer workspace

Import the project façade and SCNSim's shared unit registry.

```{python}
#| id: consumer-imports
from circuit_model import ResonatorTarget, optimize_resonator, resolve_resonator
from scnsim import units as u
```

## Declare the project-owned target

The target stays outside SCNSim and keeps every physical value unit-aware.

```{python}
#| id: consumer-target
target = ResonatorTarget(
    frequency=6.2 * u.GHz,
    linewidth=2.0 * u.MHz,
)
workspace = "results/team_resonator_optimization"
```

## Run the team-owned workflow

The façade returns exact typed Results without storing a hidden current result.

```{python}
#| id: consumer-run
optimization, report = optimize_resonator(
    target=target,
    workspace=workspace,
)
```

## Inspect the returned Results

Presentation is separate from execution and does not recompute either request.

```{python}
#| id: consumer-results
optimization.show()
report.show()
```

## Resolve the exact request after restart

The façade reconstructs the same sealed request and never searches for a latest
run or recomputes missing work.

```{python}
#| id: consumer-resolve
resolved = resolve_resonator(target=target, workspace=workspace)
resolved.best.parameters
```
